title: Future Perfect & Continuous
completion_message: ¡Excelente! Dominar el Future Perfect y el Future Continuous te da una proyección altamente profesional para hablar de planes a futuro.

parts.visual:
Future Perfect: Se usa para acciones que estarán TERMINADAS antes de un momento específico en el futuro. 
Estructura: will have + participio. 
Ej: By next year, we WILL HAVE LAUNCHED the new app. (Para el próximo año, habremos lanzado la nueva app).
parts.audio: Future Perfect. We use it for actions that will be finished before a specific time in the future. The structure is: will have, plus the past participle. For example: By next year, we will have launched the new app.

parts.visual:
Future Continuous: Se usa para acciones que estarán EN PROGRESO en un momento específico del futuro. 
Estructura: will be + gerundio (-ing). 
Ej: At this time tomorrow, I WILL BE NEGOTIATING with the CEO. (A esta hora mañana, estaré negociando con el CEO).
parts.audio: Future Continuous. We use it for actions that will be in progress at a specific time in the future. The structure is: will be, plus an i n g verb. For example: At this time tomorrow, I will be negotiating with the CEO.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la forma futura correcta (Future Perfect o Future Continuous).

questions.question: By 2030, we ____ our expansion to Europe. (Habremos terminado - acción completada antes del 2030).
questions.explanation: Future Perfect: By + momento futuro, indica que la acción estará completada.

questions.question: At 10:00 AM tomorrow, I ____ to London. (Estaré volando - acción en progreso).
questions.explanation: Future Continuous: En ese momento exacto la acción estará ocurriendo.

questions.question: Don't call me at 2:00 PM. I ____ a meeting with the client. (Estaré teniendo).
questions.explanation: Acción en progreso a las 2:00 PM.

questions.question: By the end of this month, we ____ our sales targets. (Habremos alcanzado).
questions.explanation: By the end = para el final (acción completada = Future perfect).

questions.question: This time next week, we ____ on a beach in Hawaii! (Estaré relajándome).
questions.explanation: This time next week = a esta hora la próxima semana (acción en progreso).

questions.question: By 5:00 PM today, I ____ all the reports. (Habré escrito).
questions.explanation: Para las 5:00 PM la acción estará terminada.

questions.question: By the time you arrive, the meeting ____. (Habrá empezado).
questions.explanation: Para cuando llegues, la acción ya se habrá completado (habrá empezado).

questions.question: Tomorrow morning at 9, she ____ a presentation. (Estará dando).
questions.explanation: A las 9 en punto, la acción estará en pleno progreso.

questions.question: By next December, I ____ at this company for ten years. (Habré trabajado).
questions.explanation: Para el próximo diciembre, se habrán cumplido 10 años.

questions.question: I can't meet you on Saturday. I ____ all day. (Estaré trabajando).
questions.explanation: Acción en progreso durante todo el sábado.

questions.question: By the time the manager returns, we ____ the problem. (Habremos resuelto).
questions.explanation: Para cuando regrese, el problema ya estará resuelto.

questions.question: They ____ the new system by Friday. (Habrán instalado).
Next Tuesday at 3 PM, they ____ the budget. (Estarán discutiendo).
questions.explanation: Momento exacto en el futuro (en progreso).

questions.question: Call me after 8 PM. We ____ dinner by then. (Habremos terminado).
questions.explanation: By then = para entonces (ya estará terminada).

questions.question: I hope we ____ a profit by the end of the year. (Habremos obtenido/hecho).
Please don't call the office at lunchtime. The secretary ____ lunch. (Estará comiendo).
questions.explanation: Acción en progreso durante la hora del almuerzo.

questions.question: We ____ 1,000 units by next week. (Habremos vendido).
questions.explanation: By next week = completado (will have + participio).

questions.question: At midnight, we ____. (Estaré durmiendo).
By 2040, many traditional jobs ____. (Habrán desaparecido).
In five years' time, I ____ my own company. (Estaré dirigiendo/manejando).

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe la forma correcta del verbo.

questions.question: By 5 PM, I will ____ finished the report. (Habré)
By next year, we will have ____ (launch) the app. (Lanzado)
At 10 AM tomorrow, I will ____ flying. (Estaré)
At 2 PM, we will be ____ (discuss) the budget. (Discutiendo)
By Friday, they ____ have signed the contract. (Habrán)
By 2030, we will have ____ (reach) our goal. (Alcanzado)
Don't call me at 9. I will ____ presenting. (Estaré)
Tomorrow morning, I will be ____ (work). (Trabajando)
By December, I will have ____ (make) a million dollars. (Hecho)
In ten years, we will be ____ (live) on Mars. (Viviendo)

pairs.target: Acción en progreso en el futuro
